messages.subject: getCov doesn't do its job
parts:
Hi,

I think I found a bug? I created a 40x40 correlation matrix with 1s on the diagonal, correctly converted to a covariance matrix using cor2cov  with standard deviations. I then turned the NA cells into whitespace, making it a character matrix. Lastly, I used getCov to double the matrix up. However, this changes already present values. Notably, values on the diagonal, which should be close to each other, take on values far below 1, but there are also other changes. Is this intended? The manual makes no mention of changing already present values and this is not what the function should be doing.

Regards,

Sercan

messages.subject: Re: getCov doesn't do its job
parts:
Not sure why you have NA cells or need to convert them to whitespace, or why you need getCov() if you already have the covariance matrix from cor2cov().  But posting your actual syntax (and data) would help readers figure out what the problem is.
